# Adding Neighbourhood Geographies
```{r}
package <- show_package("fc443770-ef0a-4025-9c2c-2cb558bfab00")
package
```

```{r}
resources <- list_package_resources("fc443770-ef0a-4025-9c2c-2cb558bfab00")
	
datastore_resources <- filter(resources, tolower(format) %in% c('csv', 'geojson'))

torontonbh <- filter(datastore_resources, row_number()==1) %>% get_resource()
```

# Adding Neighbourhood Profiles
```{r}
nbhdata <- read_xlsx("neighbourhood-profiles-2021-158-model.xlsx")
```

# Swapping Rows and Columns of Neighbourhood Profiles. Processing Columns of Interest.
```{r}
nbhdata_transpose <- data.frame(t(nbhdata[-1]))

#Renaming Columns of Interest
nbhdata_transpose <- rename(nbhdata_transpose, "AREA_SHORT_CODE" = 1)
nbhdata_transpose <- rename(nbhdata_transpose, "MEDIAN_AGE" = 35)
nbhdata_transpose <- rename(nbhdata_transpose, "MEDIAN_INCOME_2020" = 63)

#Making Columns of Interest Numeric for Analysis
nbhdata_transpose <- nbhdata_transpose %>%
  mutate(MEDIAN_AGE = as.numeric(as.character(MEDIAN_AGE)))
nbhdata_transpose <- nbhdata_transpose %>%
  mutate(MEDIAN_INCOME_2020 = as.numeric(as.character(MEDIAN_INCOME_2020)))
```
```{r}
nbhdata_transpose
```
# Joining nbhdata to torontonbh geometries
```{r}
torontodata <- left_join(torontonbh, nbhdata_transpose, by = "AREA_SHORT_CODE")
torontodata
```

# Adding Bike Station Data
```{r}
bstations <- read_xlsx("Toronto_Bikeshare_Stations.xlsx")
```

```{r}
summary(bstations)
head(bstations)
```

# Creating Bike Share Geography from Data
```{r}
bstations.sf<- st_as_sf(x = bstations, coords = c("X", "Y"), crs = 4326)
```

# Plotting Bike Share Points and Neighbourhood Map
```{r}
ggplot() +
  geom_sf(data = torontodata, colour ="black", fill = NA, alpha = 1, size = .3)  +
  geom_sf(data = bstations.sf) +
  coord_sf()
```
# Plotting Median Income on Toronto Map
```{r}
ggplot(torontodata) + 
  geom_sf(aes(fill = cut_number(MEDIAN_INCOME_2020, 5)), color = NA, size = 0.1) +
    geom_sf(data = torontonbh, colour ="black", fill= NA, alpha = 1, size = .3) +
  scale_fill_brewer(palette = "YlOrRd") +
  coord_sf() +
  labs(fill = "Median Income in 2020")
```
